## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-302-01` — A 100,000-child directory does not trigger 100,000 full directory listings or retain all entry metadata across slices.
- `AC-302-02` — Cancellation, pause, restart, and concurrent filesystem changes converge without permanent skips or false completeness.
